entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed. I bought a ProFit jersey a while back and it's just not right.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling. Order number is VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this. I really needed the money back if it didn't work out.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the ProFit jersey here. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size. I followed the chart, I really did, but it's just way too tight across the chest. I was hoping to exchange it at first, but now I just... I think I'd rather have the refund.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for performance. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay. It looks like it was delivered 42 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy and sad about it sitting in the closet. I was really hoping you could help me out.

Of course, Mark. I'm checking our policy now. And... yes, good news. Our standard return policy covers items for 90 days from the delivery date, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, wow. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried.

It's my pleasure. I'm glad we could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return in our system and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging if you can, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
That's perfect. You've really turned my day around. Thank you again for your help.
You are very welcome, Mark. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
